question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4575ffd0b30ddfe830ca81931502e3243f41e7b52adbe1b80be7a02b882adb67.png]
solution:
The logic follows here is :

**Pattern of L:**

 
• L-shaped symbol rotate 90o clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01f5a142b4089ddaa0e61cbf4677c15b1cbc3ecce92e3c542ab40721043736d6.png] 

**Pattern of * and ⦻ :**

 
• sign ***** and **⦻** alternatively change clockwise rotation at corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54497cf3724dbcb75fb8aa6906180fc9e4429eff93aeeca54c27d9a865c2aa95.png] 

**Pattern of triangle:**

 
• Numbers of tringle increase in every rotation on Right upper hand side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c93dd402a229177e0b15dda86bb1688d997b2e7bf6db06b0b4ad01de428fe478.png] 

So next figure looks like,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc5618007f280013b67784b18d9210782cef1223b24815dd81f8f5946945b46f.png] 

Hence, '**option 1'** is the correct answer.
